raw.details:
Overview

WebRush is a fully online, individual frontend development hackathon where participants will have 6 hours to transform a given challenge into a complete, polished, and functional web experience.

This is a frontend-only competition focused on creativity, UI/UX, responsiveness, interaction, and implementation skills.

Challenge

At the start of the hackathon, one common challenge/problem statement will be provided to all participants.

Participants must build their solution entirely within the given 6-hour time limit.

The challenge is simple:

You get one problem. You get 6 hours. Build the best web experience you can.

Participants are expected to turn the given idea into a visually appealing, responsive, interactive, and well-executed frontend website.

Technology & Tools

  • Participants are free to use any frontend technology, framework, library, or development tool.
  • HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, and other frontend technologies are allowed.
  • Participants may use modern frontend development tools and libraries as required.
  • Backend technologies and backend implementation are NOT allowed.
  • No backend server, database, authentication system, or server-side application is required for the solution.

Participation

  • Individual participation only
  • Each participant must develop and submit their own solution.
  • Team participation is not allowed.
  • The event is completely online.

Duration

The total development time is strictly limited to 6 hours.

Participants must:

  • Receive the challenge.
  • Plan and design their solution.
  • Develop the frontend.
  • Test and optimize the website.
  • Deploy and submit their final solution within the given 6-hour window.

Submission

Participants will be required to submit their completed project before the deadline.

The submission may include:

  • Live deployed website
  • GitHub repository
  • Short project description
  • Technologies/tools used
  • Any additional details requested by the organizers

Rules

  • The event is frontend-only.
  • Individual participation only.
  • All participants will receive the same challenge.
  • The solution must be created within the 6-hour hackathon window.
  • Frontend frameworks, libraries, UI libraries, and development tools are allowed.
  • Backend tools/technologies are not allowed.
  • Participants cannot submit a previously built project.
  • The submitted project should be relevant to the given challenge.
  • The final submission must be made before the deadline.
  • Late submissions may not be considered for evaluation.
  • Participants are responsible for ensuring that their deployed website and repository are accessible to the organizers/judges.
  • Any form of plagiarism or submission of someone else's work may lead to disqualification.
  • The organizers reserve the right to disqualify submissions that violate the rules.

Evaluation

Projects will be evaluated based on:

  • UI/UX & Visual Design
  • Creativity & Innovation
  • Functionality & Interactivity
  • Responsiveness
  • Code Quality
  • Overall Execution of the Challenge

The objective is not just to build a website, but to see how effectively you can turn a problem statement into a polished frontend experience in just 6 hours.

The WebRush Challenge

One Challenge. One Participant. Six Hours. One Final Submission.

Can you design, build, and ship a standout frontend experience before time runs out?

Welcome to WebRush.
